name: sfc /scannow
title: Verify Protected Windows System Files
summary: Scans protected Windows files and attempts to replace corrupted copies. Microsoft recommends updating and restarting Windows, then completing DISM RestoreHealth before this repair command.

examples.description: Runs a complete protected-system-file scan from an elevated Command Prompt after the recommended DISM repair step.

permissions.notes: Run only from Command Prompt opened as administrator and follow organizational change policy.

risk.warning: SFC may replace protected Windows files. Save work, follow Microsoft's recommended DISM-then-SFC sequence, and do not interrupt the scan.
